integrity: The seven-graph exact rational checker validates 398 finite edge columns; the proof of all parameters and asymptotics is analytical. The finite checks are not a substitute for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Canonical Euclidean-orthogonal projections only, unweighted real edge spaces, m>=3 and n>=5. No global projection minimality, weighted generality, intermediate exponent norm, or uniformity in growing m claimed. Independent mathematical audit not performed; residual literature risk remains.
title: Endpoint Hodge norms and a sharp projection-dominance transition on cyclic clique cylinders
